mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 2000 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 2000, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% and increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 150,000 signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production index (INDPRO) above 110 signals increased economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when INDPRO > 110 are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) below 2% annualized growth rate signals decreased aggregate demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of instances when GDPC1 < 2%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% and decrease in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) below 2% signals a monetary policy-driven decrease in inflation expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal: the labor market's inherent momentum, as proxied by payroll employment (PAYEMS), drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal: in a post-shock recovery regime, an increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 350,000 signals increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances when RSAFS > 350,000 in post-shock recovery regimes, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.
